site.name: the Surveyors' Benchmark
site.measured_gap: MEASURED 2026-10-03 (the grid of docs/world-building/CHALLENGERS_CAIRN.md 'Why here'): (3728, 5488) was 234 blocks from the nearest authored thing, and Victory Road's walked path from (3606, 5755) to (3609, 5629) is the ONLY run of a southern route with no authored thing within 300 blocks of any of its points. Picked over the slightly emptier (4784, 5328) (240 blocks, 6 more) because that one shares the Dry Cistern's sub-region 650 blocks away and stands 151 blocks off Route 8, where this one is beside the road a player walks.
site.why_here: a low rise east of Victory Road, ground y113-115 over x3684-3732, z5692-5740 (tools/ground.py, sampled every 3 blocks), on the road's open stretch between Giovanni's town and the Rift entry (data/routes.json victory_road rift_entry, (3548, 5322)): the last high ground before the road drops into the Rift, the place a survey party would set its benchmark to take the Rift's levels from. The Rift's surveyor already stands at the entry (data/npc_seats.json npc_main_rift_surveyor); this is where his people worked.
site.findable_from: MEASURED 2026-10-03 (tools/survey_benchmark.py --report): the lantern on the pillar's top is in clear sight of a standing eye from Victory Road's walked points (every 4th within 250 blocks); the report prints how many and the clearest.
site.off_path: the nearest walked point of Victory Road is 86 blocks from the whole write box (measured 2026-10-03 by the report). Outside the_rift polygon (data/regions.json, which ends at z5392-5408 here) by 270 blocks and every Rift zone; nothing in data/placements.json, data/towns.json, data/legendaries.json or data/habitat_blocks.json within 250 blocks; the Arrow Lake south-east branch's channel (data/landmarks.json) passes about 130 blocks south-west.

pillar.why: the benchmark itself: a stone-brick trig pillar 4 high on a 3 by 3 plinth, a chiselled cap, a lantern on the cap. The levels of the whole Rift Foot were taken from it.

hut.why: the survey party's hut, east of the pillar: cobblestone-footed, acacia-framed and planked, under a flat acacia slab roof, glazed on its long sides, its door in the west wall facing the pillar. Inside, the party's barrel (the find), a cartography table and an empty lectern.

stakes.why: a line of sighting stakes from the pillar toward the Rift entry, one every 12 blocks: an acacia fence post 2 high with a lantern on it, so the line shows at night and points the way the survey went.

lanterns.why: places are lit as towns (lanterns, never light blocks: docs/STATE.md): the pillar's cap, one hanging inside the hut, one on each stake.

find.why: a cache (data/rewards.json survey_benchmark_store, ADR-002), granted once per player through tools/rewards_pack.py's advancement on reaching the barrel in the hut; the barrel is scenery. An Everstone (the benchmark's reference stone: a stone that never changes, which is what a benchmark is) and two Sitrus Berries from the party's stores. Useful, not a curve-breaker: nothing on the critical path needs it.

blocks.rule: vanilla 1.21.1 only, none a spawn condition in data/spawn_blocks.json (tools/wayside_kit.py refuses the record otherwise), no chest, no bed.
